Workshop.title: Workshop
Workshop.description: Configuration and metadata for a psychology workshop owned by an organizer.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated organizer who owns this workshop.

startTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string for workshop start time.

location.description: Venue or room location for the workshop.

organizer.description: Organizer subtitle displayed on the ID card.

tagline.description: Tagline displayed on the ID card.

eventLabel.description: Event category label displayed on the ID card.

customLogoUrl.description: Optional data URI or URL for custom card logo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workshop document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workshop document was last updated.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: Workshop participant registration and real-time attendance status.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated organizer who owns this participant record.

name.description: Full name and academic/clinical title of the participant.

institution.description: Participant institution, university, or clinic affiliation.

role.description: Participant role or category (e.g., Peserta Workshop, Pembicara).

checkInTime.description: ISO-8601 check-in timestamp string (empty string if PENDING).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant record was last updated.

/workshops/{workshopId}.description: Stores workshop configuration owned by the authenticated organizer (where workshopId == ownerId).

/workshops/{workshopId}/participants/{pa.description: Stores participant registration and check-in records under a specific workshop.
